site.about: Iraady Ltd is a British-Rwandan software and AI studio headquartered in London with an operating office at Norrsken House, Kigali. Since 2021 we've shipped 30+ products across SaaS, mobile and AI — including our flagship products BizPro and NgoPlus, serving businesses and NGOs across 15+ countries. We partner with ambitious teams worldwide on projects from $1K to enterprise.
site.quote: We run our own SaaS — so when we build yours, we already know where it breaks. That's the difference between an agency and an operator.
site.markets: UK · Rwanda · Uganda · Kenya · Nigeria · DRC · France · Tanzania · Ghana · South Africa · and 5+ more

faq.q: What license comes with source-code purchases?
faq.a: Each purchase includes a commercial-use license for your organisation. Reselling raw source code is not permitted.
Checkout is processed securely through Flutterwave in USD. For larger builds, we can split milestones by agreement.

faq.q: Do you provide support and maintenance?
faq.a: Yes. Every project includes a defined support window, and longer maintenance retainers are available.
